TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Address_1
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE, (INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE #') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 4), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE #') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'SUITE') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 4), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'SUITE') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE.') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 3), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE.') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 2), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE') - 1),
in_Address_1 )

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Address_2
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE, REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE #$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE #') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)SUITE$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'SUITE') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE\.$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE.') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE') - 1),
in_Address_2 )

SELECT --'ECI_CHILD' SOURCE_TABLE, ID_CHILD as ID , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' AS PTY_REL_FK , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') AS SRC_KEY_SFX , '018' ALT_ID_TP -- ECI Child ID , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') ALT_ID_VAL , DATE_CREATED, DATE_MODIFIED , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' || '|018'||'|'|| LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') AS PKEY_SRC_OBJECT
FROM STG_ECI_D_CHILD
UNION ALL
SELECT --'ECI_CHILD' SOURCE_TABLE, ID_CHILD as ID , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' AS PTY_REL_FK , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') AS SRC_KEY_SFX , '004' ALT_ID_TP -- SSN , CHILD_SSN ALT_ID_VAL , DATE_CREATED, DATE_MODIFIED , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' || '|004'||'|'|| LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') AS PKEY_SRC_OBJECT
FROM STG_ECI_D_CHILD WHERE CHILD_SSN IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT --'ECI_CHILD' SOURCE_TABLE, ID_CHILD as ID , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' AS PTY_REL_FK , LPAD(ID_MEDICAID,9, '0') AS SRC_KEY_SFX , '002' ALT_ID_TP -- Medicaid ID , MEDICAID_NBR ALT_ID_VAL , M.DATE_CREATED, M.DATE_MODIFIED , LPAD(ID_CHILD,10, '0') || '|Member' || '|002'||'|'|| LPAD(ID_MEDICAID,10, '0') AS PKEY_SRC_OBJECT FROM STG_ECI_D_MEDICAID M INNER JOIN STG_ECI_SN_CASE C ON M.ID_CASE = C.ID_CASE

FROM STG_ECI_D_FAMILY

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION:
Check party data to see if it passes criteria to be included in the MDM. If not, record keys in a deactivation list that is used as a filter in subsequent jobs. Handle reactivations (removal from deactivation list).
DEACTIVATION_STS In the PTY_INACTIVE_STS table is populated as follows H - Records were deactivates as the time of the historical load so record was never loaded into the MDM P - Deactivation is pending (to be processed) D - Deactivated (Hub state ind = 1 in MDM)
[MLayne 09/26/2024] Added FAMILY to data source (Previously only CHILD)
[MLayne 10/17/2024] Added name mapplet, which changes malformed names to null, before the check for null names. (Response to iTest finding)
[MLayne 12/20/24] Removed source system from XREF lookup criteria as the MDM source system is padded with blanks (Response to iTest finding). [MLayne 1/10/2025] Changed duplicate case lookup (Reason code 8) to use a view that includes family IDs.

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Exception_Desc_Name
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(True, MISSING_FIRST_NM_Fl = 'Y' ,'Missing First Name', MISSING_LAST_NM_Fl ='Y','Missing Last Name',NULL)

GROUP.NAME: Invalid_Party_Name
GROUP.EXPRESSION: (Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))=0 OR Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(FIRST_NAME) OR IsNULL(LAST_NAME) ) -- Suppress name exception when family is already marked as inactive AND FAM_INACTIVE_YN = 'N'

GROUP.NAME: Deactivation
GROUP.EXPRESSION: Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))=0 OR Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(FIRST_NAME) OR IsNULL(LAST_NAME) OR NOT IsNull(OMIT_ID) -- i.e. all cases are reason cd 8 OR FAM_INACTIVE_YN = 'Y'

GROUP.NAME: Reactivation
GROUP.EXPRESSION: NOT IsNull(DEACTIVATION_STS) and Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))>0 and Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))>0 and IsNull(OMIT_ID) -- i.e. NOT flagged as a duplicate and FAM_INACTIVE_YN='N'

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(True, Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(FIRST_NAME) ,'Missing First Name', Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(LAST_NAME),'Missing Last Name')

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(True, Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(FIRST_NAME) ,'First Name', Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(LAST_NAME),'Last Name')

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_Name
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(True, Length(Rtrim(FIRST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(FIRST_NAME) ,FIRST_NAME, Length(Rtrim(LAST_NAME))=0 OR IsNULL(LAST_NAME),LAST_NAME)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Exception_Code_Name

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Addr_Issue_Desc
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
Decode(True,
Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd != '002' AND MailabilityScore <= '3', 'Invalid Address', -- Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd = '002' AND MailabilityScore < '3' AND IN(SUBSTR(MatchCode,1,1),'I','N'), 'Invalid Address', -- ISNULL(Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd), 'Invalid Address Type', NULL)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Score
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
--IIF(MailabilityScore<= '3','40','100') Decode(True, --If Address Type is not Physcial Mail and --mailability scores are equal or less than 3 , then route mails to exception queue Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd != '002' AND MailabilityScore <= '3','40',
--If Address Type is Physcial Mail and --mailability scores are less than 3, Check Match --codes as well. If the Match code starts with I or N , then --route mails to exception queue else consider it as valid --address.
Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd = '002' AND MailabilityScore < '3' AND IN(SUBSTR(MatchCode,1,1),'I','N'),'40',
-- If valid Address Type is not returned from Lookup Code value table, the record should be routed to Exception.This is applicable for P23 since we are not receiving Address Type from P23
ISNULL(Addr_Tp_Mstr_Cd), '40', '100')
